  nanoboy/Runtime/GbaCheatCipher.cs
  nanoboy/Runtime/GbaCheatTables.cs
Changes: managed arrays and spans, cloned per-set cipher state, bounded input
and integration with AetherBoy's independently implemented cheat interpreter.
